subject: Mutual Action Plan (Weekly) — Executive update & SLA exception request
messages:
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@heliohealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan checkpoint (weekly)

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Thanks for the weekly sync yesterday. Quick update from our side: after running the evaluation plan this week we hit a throughput ceiling on our integration tests around peak profile (short bursts of 220 concurrent streams). Our internal SREs believe this may trigger an SLA exception if we hit production shape.

We need to lock down a short-term priority support path while we finalize the rollout. Specifically:
- A one-week elevated support window (Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00 PT) with a named Redwood on-call engineer.
- Permission to route to a higher-capacity model instance during peak windows (we can accept slightly higher unit cost for the next 10 business days).
- Confirmation that request-level tracing and token-level cost exports are enabled for our account for audit.

Attached: helio_map_v4.pdf with the latest milestone dates and the evaluation pass results.

Can you confirm next steps and whether Redwood can sign off on the short-term SLA exception? Priya (our exec sponsor) is copied to expedite.

Thanks,
Carlos
Lead Systems Engineer
HelioHealth

--
Attachment: helio_map_v4.pdf (application/pdf, 412KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan checkpoint (weekly)

Carlos — thanks for the clear summary and for flagging Priya. We read the evaluation artifacts and appreciate the reproduction steps you included. We can support the short-term path requested while we complete the rollout guardrails. Proposed actions from Redwood: 

1) Priority support window: Redwood will provide an elevated response SLA (30-minute acknowledge, 4-hour mitigation) Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00 PT for the next 10 business days. Laura will own the on-call roster; Aditya will be the named escalation lead.

2) Temporary routing: We can route a subset of traffic to a higher-capacity Dedicated pool during your peak windows. This will incur additional committed-cost exposure; we’ll surface the impact in the billing note.

3) Observability: Enabled request-level tracing and token-level cost exports for HelioHealth (verified). We’ll provide access links within 24 hours.

Action items assigned: 
- Laura: confirm on-call calendar and named engineer(s) by 2026-09-09 EOD.
- Aditya: prepare the routing playbook + cost estimate by 2026-09-09 EOD.
- Monica: generate a short SLA exception form and DocuSign link for exec sign-off by 2026-09-09 noon.

I’ve attached a draft SLA exception form (sla_exception_form.docx) for your review. If Priya can sign the exception we’ll proceed immediately to enact the elevated routing.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference

--

Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan checkpoint (weekly) -- internal escalation

Folks — forwarding HelioHealth's ask. Quick notes from my side after reviewing Carlos' load graphs:

- On-call: I can staff Jane K. (ops lead) + one secondary for the window. Jane has experience with continuous batching issues and kernel timeouts.
- Routing: We should scope this as a short-lived policy change with an automatic revert after 10 business days. Aditya — please prepare traffic-shift runbook (small % then ramp to target). Include acceptance criteria and rollback triggers.
- Cost: This will be a mix of short-term Dedicated capacity and small burst overages. Flag finance if estimated incremental > $25k.

I requested Monica to draft the exception doc and a one-pager for Priya (exec sponsor). Monica, can you have both artifacts and the DocuSign link by 09/09 12:00 PT?

Thanks — Laura
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
